To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• A standards-based professional development system is feasible and can be developed by the profession itself.
a standards-based professional certification system can be developed by teachers themselves, and it can be implemented in schools with the full support of school principals.

a system that rewards and recognises successful teaching practice can be created and operated by the teaching professionals themselves, and that this system can be designed in a way that it is consistent with the goals of the education system and the needs of teachers and their employers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
developing an understanding of the nature of teaching expertise and the ways in which this expertise can be recognised and rewarded through a system of certification.
the following questions: What do we mean by ‘accomplished teaching’ and what are the key features of a standards-based system for recognising accomplished teaching?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the development of a standards-based professional certification system for teachers is a major challenge for teacher associations and the profession.
the professional learning and certification of accomplished teachers is the most important challenge facing the teaching profession.
a standards-based certification system has the ability to provide a framework for teachers to improve their teaching practices, and to recognise and reward accomplished teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an approach that has the potential to provide a system of professional learning and certification that is both rigorous and fair.

we have shown that it is possible for the profession, with support from the government, to design and operate a standards-based professional development system for teachers that is based on successful teaching practice, and that can be used to reward and promote teachers.
the development of a standards-based professional system of teacher learning is a major challenge.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of a standards-based professional certification system for teachers is a long-term project that requires the commitment of teachers, teacher associations, teacher education institutions and government.
the teaching profession can take the lead in designing a standards-based professional development system that recognises and rewards accomplished teaching practices.
a system for recognises successful teaching practices is feasible, and that the profession can be trusted to develop and operate a system of this kind.
